description.plain: Paragon PBP1557 Brake Pads Paragon brake pads offer excellent overall braking performance optimized for a wide range of motorsport, high performance, and sport driving applications. Manufactured by Winmax Japan, a highly recognized manufacturer with 60 years of experience in manufacturing high performance brake pads, to deliver superior stopping power, excellent modulation and control, durability, reliability, high fade resistance, and consistent performance under high temperature conditions. Race proven friction materials, perfect match with Paragon rotors to allow confidence at every braking point, lap after lap. Direct OEM replacement. ***Manufactured by Winmax for Paragon Performance. Made in Japan. Common applications: 2017-2021 Honda Civic Type R FK8 rear 2023+ CTR FL5 Rear (11th Gen Type R) 2016-2020 Honda Civic rear (all trims) Part Number: PBP.1557.145.P2 / PBP.1557.145.P3 / PBP.1557.145.R5 / PBP.1557.145.R7 ***If you are unsure about fitment, please contact us to verify fitment for your vehicle / application. Paragon Brake Pad Compounds: P2 Compound The P2 “Sport Comfort” compound is designed for street use where balance between performance and street friendliness is emphasized. Minimal brake dust and noise due to its non-metallic material. Improved initial bite, modulation (brake control), and temperature range over stock pads. Higher coefficient of friction for increased stopping power. Excellent pad and rotor life. Works as designed from ambient temperature. Ideal for daily driven vehicles with performance in mind. Material: Non-metallic Effective temperature range: Ambient - 932°F (500°C) Average Mu: 0.29 ~ 0.32 Recommended for street use only Comparable to: Hawk HPS, Project Mu B Spec P3 Compound The P3 “Road & Track” compound is an all round compound ideal for sport driving, autocross, and light track duty while still maintaining street drivability. Low level of brake dust and noise. Good coefficient of friction, initial bite, and temperature range make this compound capable for track conditions. Best modulation and control characteristics among P series compounds. Great choice for occasional track vehicles without the disadvantages of dedicated track pads. Works as designed from ambient temperature. Great rear pad option for those who prefer a more front biased setup with the R5 compound up front. Material: Semi-metallic Effective temperature range: Ambient - 1112°F (600°C) Average Mu: 0.34 ~ 0.37 Recommended for street / track use Comparable to: Ferodo DS2500, Endless MXRS & MX72, Project Mu HC+, PFC 97, Hawk HP+, Pagid RS4-2 R5 Compound The R5 “High Friction Track / Competition” compound is designed as a dedicated track compound. High coefficient of friction provides sufficient stopping power for track and competition conditions. Precise modulation and release characteristics. Highly fade resistant with wide temperature range. Flatter torque curve compared to the R7 compound, providing consistent and solid braking performance throughout the effective temperature range which boosts driver’s confidence. Elevated noise and brake dust compared to P2 and P3 compounds. Relatively easy on rotors compared to competitors’ racing pad offerings. Great front pad option for lighter cars, and rear pad option for those who prefer a more front biased setup with the R7 compound up front. Material: Metallic Effective temperature range: 212°F - 1382°F (100°C - 750°C) Average Mu: 0.40 ~ 0.43 Recommended for track use Comparable to: Endless CC38(ME22) & CC-Rg, Project Mu Racing 777, Ferodo DSUNO & DS3000 , Cobalt XR3 & XR4, Pagid RST3, RS44 & RS19, CL RC6 R7 Compound: The R7 “Maximum Friction Track / Competition” compound is a full race compound with maximum coefficient of friction. With higher stopping power and maximum effective operating temperature, the R7 compound is ideal for advanced high speed track events, competitions, and heavier cars that require maximum braking performance. Good modulation and release characteristics. Excellent pad and rotor life. Higher fade resistance compared to the R5 compound, with solid pedal feel throughout the effective temperature range. Material: Metallic Effective temperature range: 212°F - 1562°F (100°C - 850°C) Average Mu: 0.48 ~ 0.53 Recommended for track use only Comparable to: Endless CC60(N30C), Cobalt XR1 & XR2, Pagid RS29, Ferodo DS3000+ ***Track and race pads are not recommended to be used on streets due to elevated brake dust and noise level, possibly higher pad and rotor wear during low speed brake events, and being not able to work 100% as designed at ambient temperature. If these downsides of dedicated track and race pads are not an issue, they can be used on streets absolutely fine.

description.plain: The design philosophy behind our big brake kit for the 10th and 11th generation Honda Civic centers on intelligent standardization. By utilizing a widely available 312x25mm rotor size—common across various applications including the 10th and 11th Generation civic Si—we ensure not only optimal braking performance but also maximize ease of maintenance and parts accessibility. This approach eliminates the need for proprietary rotors, helping source replacements more quickly and affordably. Equally important, the caliper design accommodates the same brake pad profile used in the high-performance FK8 Civic Type R. This strategic decision leverages an existing performance-proven pad format while simplifying logistics for customers. Whether it's for daily driving, spirited weekend use, or track sessions, users benefit from a system engineered with both performance and practicality in mind—delivering OEM-level serviceability without compromise. The braking system on the Civic Si and Acura Integra was never designed with serious performance driving in mind. The factory single-piston floating caliper gets the job done under light conditions — but once heat builds or pedal pressure increases, it shows its limits fast. PRL’s 4-Piston Big Brake Kit is a purpose-built solution for drivers who demand more. Engineered in-house, this fixed caliper design improves pad contact, pedal feel, thermal stability, and overall stopping confidence — without compromising street drivability. This bolt-on kit is designed and engineered to work directly with your OEM 312mm rotor and integrates cleanly with the stock hub and knuckle setup. The kit also includes steel braided brake lines, offering you better pedal feel and improved confidence when braking harder at higher speeds. A future larger rotor variant is under consideration, but this initial release focuses on fit, performance, and reliability right out of the box. *In order to be compatible with a 355mm rotor variant, installation will require an alternate bracket. Quick Specs: Caliper Material and Construction: Forged 6061-T6 aluminum, 2-piece body Piston Design: 44mm primary / 41mm secondary Aluminum 6061-T6 Billet with vented Type 3 hard anodized pistons Bracket Material: CNC-machined 4140 billet steel with electrocoated finish Pad Compatibility: FMSI D1001 (F50 / Type R / STI pad shape) Rotor Fitment: OEM 312mm x 25mm rotor (10th & 11th Gen Civic Si, 2023+ Integra) Weight (per side): Approx. 8.8 lbs with bracket and hardware Finish: Hard anodized caliper body for thermal resistance, corrosion protection, and clean aesthetics Brake Lines: Kit includes a set of stainless steel braided brake lines (required, not optional) Vehicle Fitment: 2017–2021 Honda Civic Si (HC10) 2022+ Honda Civic Si (HC11) 2023+ Acura Integra (DE4) Many other Honda models when using the 312mm Si rotor Note: Designed and engineered to work with Honda OEM spec 312mm rotors. Clearance should be verified with included printable template due to dimensional increases over stock. Fitment Notes: Compared to the factory floating caliper, the PRL caliper increases outward width by approximately 25mm and vertical height by 30mm on both top and bottom — a total increase of 60mm in overall height. These changes provide greater thermal mass and improved pad contact geometry but may affect clearance on some wheels. To help with this we are providing a digital PDF template that can be printed out and used to test the fitment and spacing of the brake caliper kit on your wheels. description.plain: The HEL Performance Honda Civic Si braided brake line kit has been manufactured in-house, assembled, and machine-crimped directly onto high-quality stainless steel braided hose ensuring an exact match to your standard brake hoses. Each HEL brake line kit arrives complete with every essential component, resulting in a smooth and straightforward installation. What are the Benefits? Eliminates soft, sponge-like braking and delivers consistent performance Standard rubber brake hoses expand under pressure, especially during harsh braking, resulting in a soft, and unpredictable brake pedal feel. Featuring a 3-layer construction, HEL braided brake hoses can withstand both extreme pressures and temperatures generated during demanding conditions, promoting new levels of braking response, modulation, and control. Standard rubber brake hoses have a lifespan of about 5 years before needing to be replaced. Why settle for inferior brake lines when HEL replacements, priced similarly, offer a lifetime of reliability? Unrivaled durability and abrasion resistance While other manufacturers cut corners with zinc-plated fittings, HEL takes pride in manufacturing every brake hose fitting in-house using high-quality 303/304 grade stainless steel. HEL braided brake hoses feature a robust PTFE inner core, renowned for its exceptional chemical resistance and extreme temperature tolerance. Unlike traditional rubber hoses, the PTFE core shields against perishing or cracking, even over long periods of time. Reinforcing the PTFE core is a high-strength stainless steel overbraid, providing further protection against wear and tear. As a final layer of safeguarding, a clear or colored wipe-clean PVC cover finishes the hose neatly and protects body panels and paintwork from becoming marred or scratched. Built to last, backed by the no-quibble HEL Lifetime Warranty Having full control over the in-house manufacturing process puts HEL in the position to promise you that there is no doubt in their quality, and it is something HEL is extremely proud of. All HEL brake hoses are tested to extremes in the laboratory, and on the racetrack, where they're proven time and time again. Enhanced aesthetics and customization With multiple hose color options available, you have the freedom to customize your brake line kit to coordinate with your color scheme. If you prefer the OEM look, classic opaque Black seamlessly blends in. However, for those looking to make a statement, HEL offers a diverse range of colors to complement most preferences. HEL's unique, trend-setting hose fitting and ferrule design Every HEL Performance brake line fitting features a unique internal multi-groove design. During the assembly process, as the hose fitting and ferrule are swaged onto the hose, the PTFE inner core is pushed into three internal grooves. These grooves are dual-purpose: they form internal sealing o-rings and they enable the free and secure rotation of the fittings post-hydraulic swaging. This innovative design not only maintains the integrity of the hose but also guarantees that the fittings remain securely in place. In bespoke applications, this promotes the ability to cleverly rotate the fittings whilst in position to finesse the fitment. The hose ferrule features an internally located locking groove, which securely aligns with a channel on the hose fitting. Once swaged together, this mechanism ensures that the hose fitting will never detach from the hose. Why choose HEL Performance? Superior quality - like no other What sets HEL apart is simple yet significant; HEL handles the entire manufacturing process in-house for the complete range of stainless steel brake hose fittings and ferrules using an array of the latest technology CNC machinery. This gives HEL full control over the manufacturing process, leading to exceptional quality and faultless products. This commitment guarantees longevity and unwavering durability, even when used in the most demanding and challenging conditions. Road legal anywhere in the world When it comes to brakes, compromise simply isn't an option, especially in highly competitive motorsport environments where safety and victory can both depend on HEL's range of products. The entire range of HEL brake hoses comply with the strict criteria and requirements of FMVSS-106 and are supported by a wealth of certification, so you can use them anywhere in the world with utmost confidence. Simply choose your favorite hose color and click 'add to basket' to order your set of HEL brake lines. What's Stopping You? variants.title: Paragon PBP370 Front Brake Pads

description.plain: Paragon PBP370 Brake Pads Paragon brake pads offer excellent overall braking performance optimized for a wide range of motorsport, high performance, and sport driving applications. Manufactured by Winmax Japan, a highly recognized manufacturer with 60 years of experience in manufacturing high performance brake pads, to deliver superior stopping power, excellent modulation and control, durability, reliability, high fade resistance, and consistent performance under high temperature conditions. Race proven friction materials, perfect match with Paragon rotors to allow confidence at every braking point, lap after lap. Direct OEM replacement. ***Manufactured by Winmax for Paragon Performance. Made in Japan. Common applications: 17-21 Honda Civic Type R FK8 CTR front 23+ Honda Civic Type R FL5 front (11th gen) 15-16 Honda Civic Type R FK2 front Mitsubishi EVO 5-10 (CP9A, CT9A, CZ4A) front 04-17 Subaru STI front (GDB / GRF / GVF / VAB) w/ OEM Brembo 4 pot calipers Subaru BRZ Performance Package / Scion FR-S / Toyota 86 (w/ OEM Brembo calipers) front Subaru BRZ tS front 11-12 Audi RS3 (8P) front 09-14 Audi TT RS (8J) front Holden Commodore Redline w/ OEM 4 pot Brembo calipers 03-09 Cadillac CTS-V front Megane 3 RS 250 front Megane 4 RS front 12-13 Mustang Boss 302 front Part Number: PBP.0370.150.P2 / PBP.0370.150.P3 / PBP.0370.150.R5 / PBP.0370.150.R7 ***If you are unsure about fitment, please contact us to verify fitment for your vehicle / application. Paragon Brake Pad Compounds: P2 Compound The P2 “Sport Comfort” compound is designed for street use where balance between performance and street friendliness is emphasized. Minimal brake dust and noise due to its non-metallic material. Improved initial bite, modulation (brake control), and temperature range over stock pads. Higher coefficient of friction for increased stopping power. Excellent pad and rotor life. Works as designed from ambient temperature. Ideal for daily driven vehicles with performance in mind. Material: Non-metallic Effective temperature range: Ambient - 932°F (500°C) Average Mu: 0.29 ~ 0.32 Recommended for street use only Comparable to: Hawk HPS, Project Mu B Spec P3 Compound The P3 “Road & Track” compound is an all round compound ideal for sport driving, autocross, and light track duty while still maintaining street drivability. Low level of brake dust and noise. Good coefficient of friction, initial bite, and temperature range make this compound capable for track conditions. Best modulation and control characteristics among P series compounds. Great choice for occasional track vehicles without the disadvantages of dedicated track pads. Works as designed from ambient temperature. Great rear pad option for those who prefer a more front biased setup with the R5 compound up front. Material: Semi-metallic Effective temperature range: Ambient - 1112°F (600°C) Average Mu: 0.34 ~ 0.37 Recommended for street / track use Comparable to: Ferodo DS2500, Endless MXRS & MX72, Project Mu HC+, PFC 97, Hawk HP+, Pagid RS4-2 R5 Compound The R5 “High Friction Track / Competition” compound is designed as a dedicated track compound. High coefficient of friction provides sufficient stopping power for track and competition conditions. Precise modulation and release characteristics. Highly fade resistant with wide temperature range. Flatter torque curve compared to the R7 compound, providing consistent and solid braking performance throughout the effective temperature range which boosts driver’s confidence. Elevated noise and brake dust compared to P2 and P3 compounds. Relatively easy on rotors compared to competitors’ racing pad offerings. Great front pad option for lighter cars, and rear pad option for those who prefer a more front biased setup with the R7 compound up front. Material: Metallic Effective temperature range: 212°F - 1382°F (100°C - 750°C) Average Mu: 0.40 ~ 0.43 Recommended for track use Comparable to: Endless CC38(ME22) & CC-Rg, Project Mu Racing 777, Ferodo DSUNO & DS3000 , Cobalt XR3 & XR4, Pagid RST3, RS44 & RS19, CL RC6 R7 Compound: The R7 “Maximum Friction Track / Competition” compound is a full race compound with maximum coefficient of friction. With higher stopping power and maximum effective operating temperature, the R7 compound is ideal for advanced high speed track events, competitions, and heavier cars that require maximum braking performance. Good modulation and release characteristics. Excellent pad and rotor life. Higher fade resistance compared to the R5 compound, with solid pedal feel throughout the effective temperature range. Material: Metallic Effective temperature range: 212°F - 1562°F (100°C - 850°C) Average Mu: 0.48 ~ 0.53 Recommended for track use only Comparable to: Endless CC60(N30C), Cobalt XR1 & XR2, Pagid RS29, Ferodo DS3000+ ***Track and race pads are not recommended to be used on streets due to elevated brake dust and noise level, possibly higher pad and rotor wear during low speed brake events, and being not able to work 100% as designed at ambient temperature. If these downsides of dedicated track and race pads are not an issue, they can be used on streets absolutely fine.

media.alt_text: Paragon PPS370 Titanium Front Brake Pad Shims

variants.title: Paragon PPS370 Titanium Front Brake Pad Shims

description.plain: Paragon PPS370 Titanium Pad Shims Great heat management upgrade to improve braking performance for track and race applications. Paragon titanium pad shims are made of high quality Grade 5 titanium (6AL-4V / ASTM B348). Fits between the brake pads and calipers, and can act as an effective thermal barrier due to the significantly lower thermal conductivity of titanium. Reduce heat transfer from the brake pads to the calipers and brake hydraulic system to lower the operating temperature. When the rotors and pads are hot, heat transfer via the caliper pistons to the calipers and brake fluid may lead to fluid overheat and brake fade. Fluid fade will lead to soft brake pedal and affect modulation, and is dangerous when there is sudden loss of braking power at the track. Lower long term maintenance cost by protecting the caliper seals, dust boots, and brake fluid. Excessive heat will deteriorate these components a lot faster and lead to unnecessary replacement cost, plus wasted track time. Boiled fluid needs to be replaced after every track day. OEM FK8 Brembo 4 piston calipers are known for turning brown or even black after track use. This low cost solution can reduce the likelihood of discoloration. Improved safety by help preventing brake fade and failure Extend the life of brake components and lower long term maintenance cost Prevent boiled fluid/soft pedal Material: Grade 5 titanium (6AL-4V / ASTM B348) Thickness: 0.5mm (0.02") Work with stock calipers and OEM/aftermarket brake pads Set of 4 (axle set) Common applications: 17-21 Honda Civic Type R FK8 front 23+ CTR FL5 front 15-16 Honda Civic Type R FK2 front Mitsubishi EVO 5-10 (CP9A, CT9A, CZ4A) front 04-17 Subaru STI front (GDB / GRF / GVF / VAB) w/ OEM Brembo 4 pot calipers Subaru BRZ Performance Package / Scion FR-S / Toyota 86 (w/ OEM Brembo calipers) front Subaru BRZ tS front 11-12 Audi RS3 (8P) front 09-14 Audi TT RS (8J) front Holden Commodore Redline w/ OEM 4 pot Brembo calipers 03-09 Cadillac CTS-V front Megane 3 RS 250 front Megane 4 RS front 12-13 Mustang Boss 302 front

description.plain: Stopping power in your 10th or 11th Gen Civic is dictated by a handful of parts, mainly your brake rotors and pads. When you apply pressure to your brake pedal, hydraulic fluid is forced into your brake caliper that then acts to squeeze the set of brake pads against the rolling brake rotors. Kinetic energy is converted in thermal energy and you come to a complete stop. But what happens if you want better stopping power? The first agenda is finding a better brake pad! Choosing a brake pad is a balancing act. On one extreme you have OEM brake pads. They do the job fine for daily driving duty and last a good bit of time while giving off little dust. They’re based on a Ceramic compound. On the other extreme, you have a full Race brake pad. These are not good for the daily driver but they shine when you blast the race track. What if you want something in the middle with more performance that you can use every day? That’s where our 27WON Performance Pads come in. You get a set of pads that deliver consistent stopping distances when the stock brake pads would often begin to fade. You get better modulation and bite that creates predictable and linear stops every time. What you don’t get is brake noise or dust covered wheels like a Race pad delivers. Got your attention? Then read on to learn about the new 27WON performance brake pads specifically made for a simple swap from your OE pads. Brake pads construction isn't that complicated. Three things make up pads….Backing Plates, Friction Compounds, and Shims. Friction compounds are the most nuanced and are the biggest driving factor when talking about a pads ability to deliver stopping power. Without getting into the weeds and for best practices sake, you want to match your friction compound for your intended use and figure out the trade-offs involved in a way suited to your specific case. For performance pads, metallic and semi-metallic compounds used to be the norm. They had excellent stopping power but also tended to be harsher on rotor life and they gave off lots of dust and noise. Then, ceramic compounds came onto the scene. They eliminated most of the dust, were more rotor friendly and almost silent. But these gave up some performance. Now, hybrid ceramic/metallic compounds have entered the chat and that’s what’s used in the 27WON pads. It’s the best of both worlds without any of the drawbacks…almost a perfect middle ground if you ask us. When we set out to develop the ultimate Street and light duty track pad you see here, it was important that we didn’t lose any of the characteristics that make the OEM Honda pads good for a daily and only build upon these positives. This meant choosing a hybrid ceramic/metallic compound we touched upon above. This compound has a very wide average coefficient of friction rating of (Mu) 0.4-0.5 with an average effective operating range of ambient – 600C. This means that when your pads are cold they start with a strong rating which means a good initial bite Here’s where that upper number matters because at 0.5 Mu, the bite actually gets stronger once the brake pads heat up. That’s the ideal overall setup! This compound we keep mentioning is also easy on your OEM rotors. One drawback with high friction brake pads typically is they wear out your rotor faster. Usually, you can see that when the rotor develops a lip right at the edge where the pad ends. Because we employ a ceramic component in this pad, these pads are easier on the rotor giving it more life. It's still recommended to replace your rotors with every brake pad swap as it’s a good insurance policy to keep things well sorted. But if you’re on a budget then resurfacing your rotors is another option. Honda tends to reuse and carry over lots of components from previous models to their next generation vehicles. And, for the rear setup, that’s exactly what they did. For the front setup, Honda changed up the caliper from the 10th Gen Si FC models to the newer 11th Gen FE and Integra. So, we have unique pads for either generation of Civic or Integra you may have. For the rears, the caliper and pad size is shared across multiple models so this makes things a bit easier. One size fits all so to speak. We have bases covered all the way from the Type R 2.0T applications down through the 1.5T equipped L15 models and even the K20 NA 2.0 models. We always want to make sure every part we offer drops in and works the way the original part you removed did. So, these 27WON pads slip right in with no modifications required. Included in every set is a handy step by step guide with colored pictures so you have the confidence to install these yourself. Our pads even keep the OE style wear indicators so you know exactly when the time is right to swap out to a fresh set once yours wears down. Check out the complete details below on selecting the best brake pads for your ride "Si" what we did there? Come and get a set! If you find that your rotors are worn, warped or have a lip then replacement is advised before swapping to new pads If you you'd like even better braking performance, take a look at one of our complete big brake kit solutions for either 10th Gen or 11th Gen Civics and Integras

Paragon Brake Pad Compounds: P2 Compound The P2 “Sport Comfort” compound is designed for street use where balance between performance and street friendliness is emphasized. Minimal brake dust and noise due to its non-metallic material. Improved initial bite, modulation (brake control), and temperature range over stock pads. Higher coefficient of friction for increased stopping power. Excellent pad and rotor life. Works as designed from ambient temperature. Ideal for daily driven vehicles with performance in mind. Material: Non-metallic Effective temperature range: Ambient - 932°F (500°C) Average Mu: 0.29 ~ 0.32 Recommended for street use only Comparable to: Hawk HPS, Project Mu B Spec P3 Compound The P3 “Road & Track” compound is an all round compound ideal for sport driving, autocross, and light track duty while still maintaining street drivability. Low level of brake dust and noise. Good coefficient of friction, initial bite, and temperature range make this compound capable for track conditions. Best modulation and control characteristics among P series compounds. Great choice for occasional track vehicles without the disadvantages of dedicated track pads. Works as designed from ambient temperature. Great rear pad option for those who prefer a more front biased setup with the R5 compound up front. Material: Semi-metallic Effective temperature range: Ambient - 1112°F (600°C) Average Mu: 0.34 ~ 0.37 Recommended for street / track use Comparable to: Ferodo DS2500, Endless MXRS & MX72, Project Mu HC+, PFC 97, Hawk HP+, Pagid RS4-2 R5 Compound The R5 “High Friction Track / Competition” compound is designed as a dedicated track compound. High coefficient of friction provides sufficient stopping power for track and competition conditions. Precise modulation and release characteristics. Highly fade resistant with wide temperature range. Flatter torque curve compared to the R7 compound, providing consistent and solid braking performance throughout the effective temperature range which boosts driver’s confidence. Elevated noise and brake dust compared to P2 and P3 compounds. Relatively easy on rotors compared to competitors’ racing pad offerings. Great front pad option for lighter cars, and rear pad option for those who prefer a more front biased setup with the R7 compound up front. With higher stopping power and maximum effective operating temperature, the R7 compound is ideal for advanced high speed track events, competitions, and heavier cars that require maximum braking performance. Good modulation and release characteristics. Excellent pad and rotor life. Higher fade resistance compared to the R5 compound, with solid pedal feel throughout the effective temperature range. Material: Metallic Effective temperature range: 212°F - 1562°F (100°C - 850°C) Average Mu: 0.48 ~ 0.53 Recommended for track use only Comparable to: Endless CC60(N30C), Cobalt XR1 & XR2, Pagid RS29, Ferodo DS3000+ ***Track and race pads are not recommended to be used on streets due to elevated brake dust and noise level, possibly higher pad and rotor wear during low speed brake events, and being not able to work 100% as designed at ambient temperature. description.plain: The design philosophy behind our big brake kit for the 10th and 11th generation Honda Civic centers on intelligent standardization. By utilizing a widely available 312x25mm rotor size—common across various applications including the 10th and 11th Generation civic Si—we ensure not only optimal braking performance but also maximize ease of maintenance and parts accessibility. This approach eliminates the need for proprietary rotors, helping source replacements more quickly and affordably. Equally important, the caliper design accommodates the same brake pad profile used in the high-performance FK8 Civic Type R. This strategic decision leverages an existing performance-proven pad format while simplifying logistics for customers. Whether it's for daily driving, spirited weekend use, or track sessions, users benefit from a system engineered with both performance and practicality in mind—delivering OEM-level serviceability without compromise. The braking system on the Civic Si and Acura Integra was never designed with serious performance driving in mind. The factory single-piston floating caliper gets the job done under light conditions — but once heat builds or pedal pressure increases, it shows its limits fast. PRL’s 4-Piston Big Brake Kit is a purpose-built solution for drivers who demand more. Engineered in-house, this fixed caliper design improves pad contact, pedal feel, thermal stability, and overall stopping confidence — without compromising street drivability. This bolt-on kit is designed and engineered to work directly with your OEM 312mm rotor and integrates cleanly with the stock hub and knuckle setup. The kit also includes steel braided brake lines, offering you better pedal feel and improved confidence when braking harder at higher speeds. A future larger rotor variant is under consideration, but this initial release focuses on fit, performance, and reliability right out of the box. *In order to be compatible with a 355mm rotor variant, installation will require an alternate bracket. Quick Specs: Caliper Material and Construction: Forged 6061-T6 aluminum, 2-piece body Piston Design: 44mm primary / 41mm secondary Aluminum 6061-T6 Billet with vented Type 3 hard anodized pistons Bracket Material: CNC-machined 4140 billet steel with electrocoated finish Pad Compatibility: FMSI D1001 (F50 / Type R / STI pad shape) Rotor Fitment: OEM 312mm x 25mm rotor (10th & 11th Gen Civic Si, 2023+ Integra) Weight (per side): Approx. 8.8 lbs with bracket and hardware Finish: Hard anodized caliper body for thermal resistance, corrosion protection, and clean aesthetics Brake Lines: Kit includes a set of stainless steel braided brake lines (required, not optional) Vehicle Fitment: 2017–2021 Honda Civic Si (HC10) 2022+ Honda Civic Si (HC11) 2023+ Acura Integra (DE4) Many other Honda models when using the 312mm Si rotor Note: Designed and engineered to work with Honda OEM spec 312mm rotors. Clearance should be verified with included printable template due to dimensional increases over stock. Fitment Notes: Compared to the factory floating caliper, the PRL caliper increases outward width by approximately 25mm and vertical height by 30mm on both top and bottom — a total increase of 60mm in overall height. These changes provide greater thermal mass and improved pad contact geometry but may affect clearance on some wheels. To help with this we are providing a digital PDF template that can be printed out and used to test the fitment and spacing of the brake caliper kit on your wheels. (make sure to print in a 1:1 ratio and use tape measure to ensure printed template matches actual distances) PDF FITMENT TEMPLATE What’s in the Box: (2) PRL 4-Piston Forged Aluminum Calipers (2) Stainless Steel Braided Brake Lines (2) Application-Specific Brackets (CNC-machined steel) Full Hardware Kit: Crush washers, banjo bolts, security pins, pad spring bridges, bolts, bleeder caps ROTORS DO NOT COME WITH THIS KIT. SELECT PARAGON PADS BELOW. INSTALL GUIDE Paragon PBP370 Brake Pads Paragon brake pads offer excellent overall braking performance optimized for a wide range of motorsport, high performance, and sport driving applications. Manufactured by Winmax Japan, a highly recognized manufacturer with 60 years of experience in manufacturing high performance brake pads, to deliver superior stopping power, excellent modulation and control, durability, reliability, high fade resistance, and consistent performance under high temperature conditions. Race proven friction materials, perfect match with Paragon rotors to allow confidence at every braking point, lap after lap. Direct OEM replacement. ***Manufactured by Winmax for Paragon Performance. Made in Japan. Common applications: 17-21 Honda Civic Type R FK8 CTR front 23+ Honda Civic Type R FL5 front (11th gen) 15-16 Honda Civic Type R FK2 front Mitsubishi EVO 5-10 (CP9A, CT9A, CZ4A) front 04-17 Subaru STI front (GDB / GRF / GVF / VAB) w/ OEM Brembo 4 pot calipers Subaru BRZ Performance Package / Scion FR-S / Toyota 86 (w/ OEM Brembo calipers) front Subaru BRZ tS front 11-12 Audi RS3 (8P) front 09-14 Audi TT RS (8J) front Holden Commodore Redline w/ OEM 4 pot Brembo calipers 03-09 Cadillac CTS-V front Megane 3 RS 250 front Megane 4 RS front 12-13 Mustang Boss 302 front Part Number: PBP.0370.150.P2 / PBP.0370.150.P3 / PBP.0370.150.R5 / PBP.0370.150.R7 ***If you are unsure about fitment, please contact us to verify fitment for your vehicle / application. Paragon Brake Pad Compounds: P2 Compound The P2 “Sport Comfort” compound is designed for street use where balance between performance and street friendliness is emphasized. Minimal brake dust and noise due to its non-metallic material. Improved initial bite, modulation (brake control), and temperature range over stock pads. Higher coefficient of friction for increased stopping power. Excellent pad and rotor life. Works as designed from ambient temperature. Ideal for daily driven vehicles with performance in mind. Material: Non-metallic Effective temperature range: Ambient - 932°F (500°C) Average Mu: 0.29 ~ 0.32 Recommended for street use only Comparable to: Hawk HPS, Project Mu B Spec P3 Compound The P3 “Road & Track” compound is an all round compound ideal for sport driving, autocross, and light track duty while still maintaining street drivability. Low level of brake dust and noise. Good coefficient of friction, initial bite, and temperature range make this compound capable for track conditions. Best modulation and control characteristics among P series compounds. Great choice for occasional track vehicles without the disadvantages of dedicated track pads. Works as designed from ambient temperature. Great rear pad option for those who prefer a more front biased setup with the R5 compound up front. description.plain: The HEL Performance Honda Civic Si braided brake line kit has been manufactured in-house, assembled, and machine-crimped directly onto high-quality stainless steel braided hose ensuring an exact match to your standard brake hoses. Each HEL brake line kit arrives complete with every essential component, resulting in a smooth and straightforward installation. What are the Benefits? Eliminates soft, sponge-like braking and delivers consistent performance Standard rubber brake hoses expand under pressure, especially during harsh braking, resulting in a soft, and unpredictable brake pedal feel. Featuring a 3-layer construction, HEL braided brake hoses can withstand both extreme pressures and temperatures generated during demanding conditions, promoting new levels of braking response, modulation, and control. Standard rubber brake hoses have a lifespan of about 5 years before needing to be replaced. Why settle for inferior brake lines when HEL replacements, priced similarly, offer a lifetime of reliability? Unrivaled durability and abrasion resistance While other manufacturers cut corners with zinc-plated fittings, HEL takes pride in manufacturing every brake hose fitting in-house using high-quality 303/304 grade stainless steel. HEL braided brake hoses feature a robust PTFE inner core, renowned for its exceptional chemical resistance and extreme temperature tolerance. Unlike traditional rubber hoses, the PTFE core shields against perishing or cracking, even over long periods of time. Reinforcing the PTFE core is a high-strength stainless steel overbraid, providing further protection against wear and tear. As a final layer of safeguarding, a clear or colored wipe-clean PVC cover finishes the hose neatly and protects body panels and paintwork from becoming marred or scratched. Built to last, backed by the no-quibble HEL Lifetime Warranty Having full control over the in-house manufacturing process puts HEL in the position to promise you that there is no doubt in their quality, and it is something HEL is extremely proud of. All HEL brake hoses are tested to extremes in the laboratory, and on the racetrack, where they're proven time and time again. Enhanced aesthetics and customization With multiple hose color options available, you have the freedom to customize your brake line kit to coordinate with your color scheme. If you prefer the OEM look, classic opaque Black seamlessly blends in. However, for those looking to make a statement, HEL offers a diverse range of colors to complement most preferences. HEL's unique, trend-setting hose fitting and ferrule design Every HEL Performance brake line fitting features a unique internal multi-groove design. During the assembly process, as the hose fitting and ferrule are swaged onto the hose, the PTFE inner core is pushed into three internal grooves. These grooves are dual-purpose: they form internal sealing o-rings and they enable the free and secure rotation of the fittings post-hydraulic swaging. This innovative design not only maintains the integrity of the hose but also guarantees that the fittings remain securely in place. In bespoke applications, this promotes the ability to cleverly rotate the fittings whilst in position to finesse the fitment. The hose ferrule features an internally located locking groove, which securely aligns with a channel on the hose fitting. Once swaged together, this mechanism ensures that the hose fitting will never detach from the hose. Why choose HEL Performance? Superior quality - like no other What sets HEL apart is simple yet significant; HEL handles the entire manufacturing process in-house for the complete range of stainless steel brake hose fittings and ferrules using an array of the latest technology CNC machinery. This gives HEL full control over the manufacturing process, leading to exceptional quality and faultless products. This commitment guarantees longevity and unwavering durability, even when used in the most demanding and challenging conditions. Road legal anywhere in the world When it comes to brakes, compromise simply isn't an option, especially in highly competitive motorsport environments where safety and victory can both depend on HEL's range of products. The entire range of HEL brake hoses comply with the strict criteria and requirements of FMVSS-106 and are supported by a wealth of certification, so you can use them anywhere in the world with utmost confidence.
